# Daybloom

> Daybloom is an AI daily planner that turns a to-do list into a realistic, prioritized schedule that fits the hours you have.

Most to-do lists don't account for how long things take or what matters most.
With Daybloom, users list their tasks with rough time estimates and say how many
hours they plan to work. AI then breaks each task into at least three concrete
subtasks, gives each one a time, and orders the plan by priority. It is built
for freelancers, students, and knowledge workers who want a clear plan for the
day without spending time planning it. New accounts get free credits; paid plans
offer more credits or unlimited planning.
